nd_faq: Answers to common questions about using MalDroid Insight.
faq_sub: Quick answers about installing, data formats, accuracy and where your files are kept.
gd_cols_help: Every column of the template above, and what the tool does with it.
gd_api_title: Get a standard sample from a public dataset
gd_api_help: Downloads the first rows of a public Android malware dataset from the Hugging Face Datasets Server API, so you can see how a standard dataset is laid out and save it as a CSV to practise with. Enter a dataset id as owner/name. Needs an internet connection.
pr_need: One row per app. The model reads these {n} feature columns, matched by name: {names}. Columns that are missing are filled with 0.
pr_dl_cols: Download the column list as a blank CSV
pr_label_help: If your file already has a label column (for example Benign or the malware family), pick it here and the predictions are compared with the real labels.
